description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of exchange with effect from 04.09.2017 to 10.09.2017
reasoning: This gazette notification announces new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges, which constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations. It is issued under the authority of the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and rescinds a previous notification, making it a regulatory matter falling under Legal/Regulatory classification rather than government personnel or structural changes.
